title: Concept: Unsafe deserialization via marshal.loads (python) — review required
description: In python, marshal.loads performs object deserialization: bytes select classes and set fields, so a hostile payload can drive gadget chains or execute callbacks. The python-specific remedy is data-only decoding via JSON decoding.
applicability: python codebases decoding persisted or received bytes through marshal.loads; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Object injection leading to code execution or state corruption when hostile bytes reach the sink; HIGH severity because payloads are compact and often unauthenticated.
